Disappointment ek achha teacher hai.
"Discomfort proof hai—tum grow kar rahe."
"Karo ya na karo. Try naam ki cheez nahi."
Jitna persistent, utna lucky.
Goal se zyada, tum kya bane wo zaruri hai.
Tumhe apne mind par power hai.
"Greatness ek choice hai."
Samjhauta mat karo.
Sahi raste par baithe rehna bhi nuksaan hai.
Jo cheez worth hoti hai, easy nahi milti.
Jo tumhari soul ko jala de, uska chase karo.
Chalte raho. Sab badalta hai.
